contracts: (The S14 selector observes a distinct closure-verification result and fails when closure is omitted or inferred.) AND (Validator evaluation has a distinct, successful validator-source verification result rather than an inferred result.)

Each declared assertion needs a cer_assertion mapping and a meaningful independent oracle. Tests must invoke the real production entry. The plan is not a behavior observation. Keep governance/constraint failures non-authorizing; do not emit expected-red for them. Preserve all bound Given/When/Then and forbidden outcomes. No placeholder pass or synthetic RED.
selector_intents: Run the S14 semantic-gate selector with a closure member omitted or closure evidence derived only from another check; it must fail.
Run the semantic-gate selector with independent validator-source verification removed or substituted by another check; observe the source-verification assertion fail.
